name: Plumb
summary: A cleaning company with a facilities company's standard: white ground, ink and one kingfisher blue, Anek Latin only, sharp edges. The first screen says what it is ("Home cleaning in south-west London. Every room timed, every visit the same."), shows a bright just-cleaned room, and, attached to the photograph's lower edge, the visit as a strip: each room as wide as its minutes, a hairline for every minute, the price beside it, all from the company's own checklist and rates. Keys as a logged day, the bill worked out in front of you. For domestic and commercial cleaning companies.
